content_zh:
大夏国，天牢。
“夏侯瑜，你这个贱人，夺我武脉，废我修为，你不得好死！”
天牢中，楚峰愤怒咆哮。
他好恨。
三日前，两人相见，本以为会相守终生。
却没想到，一杯酒下肚，他便不胜酒力，醉了过去。
再次醒来，自己已经被关进了这天牢之中。
而自己的武脉被挖，丹田和经脉都被震碎。
这对于一名武者而言，简直生不如死。
不仅如此，他的手脚筋骨都被弄断，还被铁链锁在牢房墙面上。
“夏侯瑜，你这个……”
他再次的大骂了起来。
“楚峰，你发什么疯，这大半夜的还让不让人睡觉了？
你都骂了三天三夜了，你不累吗？”
这时，一名狱卒来到楚峰牢房外。
他身穿铠甲，手握铁鞭，满脸怒气。
咔嗒，牢房门打开。
“整天吵吵闹闹的，老子的清闲日子都被你给破坏了。”
说完，狱卒挥舞着鞭子狠狠的抽向楚峰。
啪。

铁链在楚峰的身上留下一道深深的血痕。
“让你骂，让你骂！”
狱卒似乎是被楚峰骂烦了，手中的铁鞭不断的抽打着。
楚峰的眼睛开始模糊，鲜血从嘴角滴落。
累。
很累。
仿佛身体被掏空了一般。
“我要死了么？”
感受到生命力在逐渐消逝，楚峰突然感觉到一种解脱。
只是，
这样窝囊的死去，我不甘心啊！
“娘，爷爷，峰儿不孝，不能报答你们了。”
楚峰的意识渐渐模糊。
“糟了，一时间头脑发热，打过头了，该不会把他打死了吧？”
那名狱卒发现了楚峰的异样，连忙停止了手中的鞭子，走近前去查探。
“还好，只是昏迷了过去，不过，也差不多快要死了。
不行，我得把他救醒，不然等上面知道了，我恐怕也要给他陪葬了。”
狱卒连忙跑出了牢房。
一盏茶后，他再次回到牢房，手中多了一个陶碗。
“哼，真是便宜你了，这灵药本来是我淬体用的，现在全都给你了。”

狱卒有些心疼。
这可是他足足攒了半年时间才凑齐的。
现在一大半都喂给了楚峰。
一碗灵药喂下，楚峰的生命力终于是稳定了下来。
但是却惨不忍睹。
content_en:
Daxia Kingdom, Tianlao.
"Xia Houyu, you bitch, take away my martial arts and destroy my cultivation, you will not die a good death!"
In the prison, Chu Feng roared angrily.
He hates it so much.
Three days ago, the two met and thought they would stay together for life.
Unexpectedly, after one glass of wine, he became overwhelmed and became drunk.
When he woke up again, he was already imprisoned in this prison.
And his martial arts veins were dug out, and his Dantian and meridians were shattered.
For a warrior, this is simply life worse than death.
Not only that, the muscles and bones of his hands and feet were broken, and he was chained to the cell wall.
"Xia Houyu, you..."
He cursed again.
"Chu Feng, why are you so crazy that you are not letting anyone sleep in the middle of the night?
You've been scolding me for three days and three nights. Aren't you tired? "
At this time, a jailer came outside Chu Feng's cell.
He was wearing armor, holding an iron whip, and his face was filled with anger.
Click, the cell door opens.
"You've been noisy all day long, and I've been ruined by you in my leisure time."
After saying that, the jailer waved his whip and whipped Chu Feng hard.
Snap.
The iron chain left a deep blood mark on Chu Feng's body.
"I'll let you scold me, I'll let you scold me!"
The jailer seemed to be tired of Chu Feng's scolding, and kept beating him with the iron whip in his hand.
Chu Feng's eyes began to blur, and blood dripped from the corners of his mouth.
tired.
very tired.
It was as if the body had been hollowed out.
"Am I going to die?"
Feeling that his vitality was gradually disappearing, Chu Feng suddenly felt a sense of relief.
Just,
I am not willing to die like this, a useless person!
"Mom, Grandpa, Feng'er is unfilial and I can't repay you."
Chu Feng's consciousness gradually blurred.
"Oops, I was so hot-headed that I hit him too much. Could I have beaten him to death?"
The jailer noticed something strange about Chu Feng, and quickly stopped the whip in his hand and walked closer to investigate.
"Fortunately, I just fainted, but I'm almost dead.
No, I have to revive him, otherwise when the higher-ups find out, I may be buried with him. "
The jailer quickly ran out of the cell.
After a cup of tea, he returned to the cell again with a clay bowl in his hand.
"Hmph, I'm really giving you an advantage. This elixir was originally used by me to temper my body, but now I give it all to you."
The jailer felt a little distressed.
This was something he spent half a year saving up.
Now most of them are fed to Chu Feng.
After feeding him a bowl of elixir, Chu Feng's vitality finally stabilized.
But it was terrible.
